extraction.title: Against the grain
extraction.subtitle: The curious rise of Chinese whisky Why one tipple is thriving in an otherwise dispirited market
extraction.summary: Chinese whisky is experiencing a surge in popularity despite a general decline in alcohol sales in China. Major distilleries are being built, and imports of whisky have reached record levels. The rise is attributed to successful overseas marketing and whisky's status as a luxury product.
